newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI Foksal 1996 audited loss PLN 31.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI Foksal 1996 audited loss PLN 31.8 mln.

text.p: National Investment Fund Foksal (No 10) said it had an audited net loss of 31.8 million zlotys in 1996, a slight decrease over the 33.6 million zlotys it previously said it lost in 1996. The fund was created in 1995.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.

From May 12 the 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme have been able to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse around mid-year.
The units lose their validity on December 31, 1998.
